production.description: Production environment variables for Cloudflare Pages

VITE_APP_TITLE.description: Application title displayed in browser and meta tags

VITE_APP_DESCRIPTION.value: Browse and discover high-quality logos and icons
VITE_APP_DESCRIPTION.description: Application description for SEO and meta tags

VITE_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for LogoBox API endpoints

VITE_CDN_BASE_URL.description: CDN base URL for serving logo assets

VITE_CATALOG_PATH.description: Path to the logo catalog JSON file (relative to CDN base URL)

VITE_LOGOS_PATH.description: Path to the logos directory (relative to CDN base URL)

VITE_CDN_FALLBACK_URL_1.description: Primary fallback CDN URL for high availability

VITE_CDN_FALLBACK_URL_2.description: Secondary fallback CDN URL for high availability

VITE_API_RETRY_ATTEMPTS.description: Number of retry attempts for failed API requests

VITE_API_RETRY_DELAY.description: Delay between retry attempts in milliseconds

VITE_ENABLE_PERFORMANCE_MONITORING.description: Enable performance monitoring (disabled in production to reduce overhead)

LOGOBOX_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for LogoBox package API calls

LOGOBOX_CDN_BASE_URL.description: CDN Base URL for LogoBox package asset retrieval

LOGOBOX_DEFAULT_VARIANT.description: Default logo variant for package usage

LOGOBOX_CACHE_ENABLED.description: Enable caching in the LogoBox package

LOGOBOX_CACHE_TTL.description: Cache TTL (Time To Live) in milliseconds for package cache (1 hour)

LOGOBOX_API_BASE_URL.description: LogoBox API base URL for dynamic generation features

preview.description: Preview environment variables for Cloudflare Pages (pull requests and development branches)

VITE_APP_DESCRIPTION.value: Browse and discover high-quality logos and icons - Preview Environment

VITE_API_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for LogoBox API endpoints (same as production for consistency)

VITE_CDN_BASE_URL.description: CDN base URL for serving logo assets (same as production)

VITE_CATALOG_PATH.description: Path to the logo catalog JSON file

VITE_API_TIMEOUT.description: API request timeout in milliseconds (shorter for faster feedback in preview)

VITE_API_RETRY_ATTEMPTS.description: Number of retry attempts (fewer for faster feedback)

VITE_API_RETRY_DELAY.description: Delay between retry attempts (shorter for faster feedback)

VITE_ENABLE_ANALYTICS.description: Disable analytics in preview to avoid polluting production data

VITE_ENABLE_PERFORMANCE_MONITORING.description: Enable performance monitoring for debugging in preview

VITE_LOG_LEVEL.description: More verbose logging for preview environment debugging

LOGOBOX_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for LogoBox package API calls (same as production)

LOGOBOX_CDN_BASE_URL.description: CDN Base URL for LogoBox package (same as production)

LOGOBOX_DEFAULT_VARIANT.description: Default logo variant for package usage

LOGOBOX_CACHE_ENABLED.description: Enable caching in the LogoBox package

LOGOBOX_CACHE_TTL.description: Cache TTL in milliseconds for preview (30 minutes - shorter for faster iteration)

LOGOBOX_API_BASE_URL.description: LogoBox API base URL for dynamic generation features

metadata.description: Environment variable configuration for LogoBox Cloudflare Pages deployment
notes: Variables prefixed with VITE_ are exposed to the frontend bundle
Variables without VITE_ prefix are build-time only
All URLs should use HTTPS in production
Cache TTL values are in milliseconds
Boolean values should be 'true' or 'false' strings
Log levels: debug, info, warn, error
Logo variants: original, optimized, black, white
security: Never include API keys, tokens, or secrets in environment variables
All sensitive authentication data should be handled through GitHub Secrets
Environment variables in Cloudflare Pages are visible in build logs
Use HTTPS for all URLs in production
